messages:
anya (eng): Postmortem uploaded. Short summary: cloud auth provider rate-limited our token refreshes during a model-registry metadata storm. Cause chain: simultaneous TTL renewals + aggressive client retries -> vendor 429s -> fallback calls hit vendor management endpoints. Impact: ~7m elevated errors for hosted-api and degraded embed jobs. Link: https://redwood.in/postmortems/1940001234
max (sre): Observed cascade at 09:42 UTC. KV-cache cold starts amplified calls. We should harden retry/backoff and add local token cache.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor acknowledges partial throttling on their token endpoint. They've requested our request ID samples and a summary of client behavior. Ticket VEND-9921 opened.
maria (security): Action item: audit service principal rotation schedule and ensure rotation jitter. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-04-05. I'll add HSM verification steps.
joanna (legal): I can extract the SLA clause about rate limiting and allowed testing. Will share language for vendor test authorization. ETA: 2026-03-28.
prakash (product): We need to classify this as recurring-risk: add label vendor-auth-blast to incident taxonomy and include in monthly risk digest. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-31.
anya (eng): Short-term mitigation: implement in-process token cache + per-process request coalescing so we don't parallel-refresh. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-03-25.
max (sre): Medium-term: implement a per-route circuit-breaker and request hedging disabled for auth endpoints. Also add alert: auth 429 > 3% sustained for 3m. Owner: max. ETA: 2026-03-29.
leo (vendor-relations): Proposed vendor test: 15-minute simulated token-rotation spike while we monitor fallbacks. Need legal sign-off. I'll coordinate.
ja (ci-bot): Automated note: created follow-up JIRA RF-2403 for token-cache work assigned to anya.
anya (eng): Quick snippet to reproduce pattern in staging: "for i in {1..200}; do curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://model-reg.internal/v1/meta & done" — will add a safer harness in CI.
maria (security): Add to runbook: exact KMS rotate steps + emergency revoke. I'll open PR to runbook repo. Owner: maria. ETA: 2026-03-27.
prakash (product): Customer comms: draft a short post explaining mitigation plan for enterprise contacts. Owner: prakash. ETA: 2026-03-26.
leo (vendor-relations): Vendor asked for a request timeline diagram. @anya can you export a 2-min trace and attach?
anya (eng): attaching trace in the postmortem doc, plus a small curl/js snippet.
max (sre): Ops checklist for dry-run: 1) enable staging throttle 2) flip circuit-breaker on 3) run CI harness 4) monitor errors and SLO deltas. I'll draft and post.
joanna (legal): Confirmed: vendor contract allows non-disruptive testing with notice. I'll prepare the notice template.
leo (vendor-relations): Tentative test windows: 2026-04-12 or 2026-04-14 evenings UTC. Will confirm by 2026-04-01.
maria (security): Also recommend adding token TTL jitter server-side and client-side to spread renewals. Add to backlog.
prakash (product): Add metric to console: auth-fail-rate by model-reg route and by tenant, so we can spot tenant-specific blast radii. Owner: product/telemetry. ETA: 2026-04-06.
anya (eng): Long-term: explore dual-auth-path option (primary vendor + backup internal short-term token service) — spike planned. Owner: anya. ETA: 2026-05-15 (spike complete).
max (sre): Tracking: I'll own the incident action tracker entries and close items as PRs merge.
leo (vendor-relations): I'll push vendor to adjust rate-limit guidance and ask for a grace window for our scheduled tests.
ja (ci-bot): Reminder: weekly follow-up reminder set for 2026-03-30.
prakash (product): Let's meet Tues 09:00 UTC to confirm owners and verify runbook PR status.
anya (eng): ack. I'll update the postmortem with the owner table and ETA milestones.
max (sre): Thanks everyone. We'll aim to shrink the blast radius and add automated detection to avoid repeat incidents. :white_check_mark:
anya (eng): End thread."
